source: Proton event logs of a 5 T polarized target, July, September and October 2022 (512-point sweeps of 212.482-213.282 MHz)

episodes.title: Reversal
episodes.what: Microwaves moved from 140.12 to 140.46 GHz, the other side of the electron line.

episodes.title: Spin-up from thermal equilibrium
episodes.what: Microwaves switched on at 140.2 GHz and stepped down to 140.1 GHz as the polarization grew.

episodes.title: Fast rise
episodes.what: The polarization appears at 24% and reaches 74% in nine minutes.
